consequence.statement: With CAInjectorMerging enabled, the ca-injector merges new CA certificates into the existing CA data instead of replacing it outright.
consequence.remediation: If you enable this gate, check that the merged CA bundles injected into your resources are what you expect.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 adds a `CAInjectorMerging` feature gate to the ca-injector. When it is enabled, the ca-injector merges new CA certificates into the existing ones instead of replacing them outright.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for feature-gate added
